items.title: Securing autonomous fleet communications at scale with mTLS over QUIC using Network Load Balancer passthrough
items.summary: Learn how to architect end-to-end mutual TLS (mTLS) authentication over QUIC using AWS Network Load Balancer passthrough mode. This post shows how to route QUIC traffic to quic-go server pods on Amazon EKS through the AWS Load Balancer Controller, with per-device certificate authentication for latency-sensitive fleet workloads such as autonomous drones.
items.creator: Priya Huddar
